h1: Custom Gray Bandanas for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom gray bandanas for your team or event. Perfect for uniforms, giveaways, and promotions. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Gray bandanas offer a neutral, versatile base for screen-printed logos, embroidered names, or heat-transferred designs. They work well for construction crews, hospitality staff, and outdoor events where a professional but understated look is needed. Choose from cotton, polyester, or blended fabrics in light or charcoal gray to match your brand colors.
heroAltText: Stack of custom gray bandanas with embroidered company logo on a table
